summary.text: Lincoln Hough, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 30, part of Greene County; he was first elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022.
He began his public service career by being elected to the Missouri House of Representatives and later served as Greene County Commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Hough graduated from Missouri State University with a bachelor's degree in political science.
He is a first-generation rancher who has owned and operated his cattle ranch since middle school, and he serves on the Greene County Farm Bureau Board of Directors.

His Senate biography says he sponsored legislation enacting the largest tax cut in state history, led the Appropriations Committee in investing in critical infrastructure, and carried legislation providing mental health resources to first responders.
His awards include Missouri Cattlemen's Association Legislator of the Year and the Missouri Chamber of Commerce Spirit of Enterprise award.
Hough is the father of two sons.
